Hello! It's wonderful that you've already found some favorites and like caro, hope you've been enjoying the game so far!

It's rather unorthodox but it's very fun (and funny) to play a dps Caraboo build, as her "snowy hex" does a good amount of damage with bonus weakness, if you invest into her e3 her exalt has great damage potential while doubling as a great support for your secondary/main dps! I highly suspect snowy hex should hold up until chapter 7-8 (the "dream of medicine" covenant from the badges shop is very worth the investment!)

There are a handful of characters who have synergy with each other (like bird twins, poison duo, lemuria), but majority of the time it's just identifying what a character *benefits from* then matching them with a character that leans into it, opposed from conflicting or making up for any weaknesses in the team (for example pcaro has survival issues, so additional healing + death res is necessary)

Arc 1 is very forgiving and for most of the stages, you can use any combo of characters and newest release characters are especially powerful. You will eventually figure out what works the more you play, or build your team around a specific stage (I had ~3 different "main" teams playing through arc 1 to counter certain enemies/stages)

The "meta" is constantly shifting and each chapter (even each stage!) has a totally different approach that's more effective, so there isn't exactly a "perfect endgame team" but rather slight adjustments or switching between teams based on the situation!

Last thing I will say is that covenants/relics are often overlooked but they make a huge difference (I have a guide for those but cheri's handbook goes over a lot!)

Sorry for the wall of text but I hope it's of any help and lmk if there's anything that needs clarifying or more questions! Have fun and good luck <:Agrippa_hug:1356083899553288382>
